# Codes

This area groups the standardized alphanumeric identifiers used within the Danish healthcare system and the DANIBD registry to track clinical interventions and pharmacological therapies for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). It covers procedure codes for surgical interventions, postoperative follow-ups, and patient education, alongside treatment codes for biological and targeted synthetic drugs (BMSL). Together, these codes form the technical foundation for national quality indicators, enabling precise measurement of reoperation rates, postoperative colonoscopies, and biologic treatment monitoring across Danish regions.

## Pages

- [[topics/codes/procedure-codes/index|Procedure Codes]] — Standardized SKS and NPU codes tracking surgical interventions, postoperative follow-ups, and patient education for IBD.
- [[topics/codes/treatment-codes/index|Treatment Codes]] — Clinical procedure codes used to register and track treatments with biological and targeted synthetic drugs (BMSL).
